title: Report completion beside accuracy
statement: Report how many learners used the material and how much of the intended work they completed beside any accuracy figure, because accuracy counts only those who finished.
example: On the course already in use, median completion was 12.5%, about 30% of the intended work.
detail: The reading project's direction review named completion as the first problem of the course already in use: median completion was 12.5%, about 30% of the intended work (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0217-team-direction-2026-09-09.qmd`). An earlier goal review ruled a rise in completion insufficient on its own and paired every completion claim with a same-student change in accuracy on near-neighbour items (`grade3-reading/artifacts/GOAL_grade3_hootl_convergence_2026_06_15.md`). Neither figure alone shows that a course works.

evidence.quote: the incumbent's real failure is 12.5% median completion, ~30% of intended work done;

Re-scope the pre-registered gate from 'completion-did-not-move = fail' to 'completion-up is INSUFFICIENT — the gate is construct-transfer'; pair every completion claim with a same-student MAP-styled near-neighbour accuracy delta (leak-probe ON)
the 39–48% sub-skill numbers are measured only on students who *did* complete items, so the 12.5% completion floor is a worse problem than the skill gap.
an instrument that was distributed in the platform and produced no actionable output went unused (18 results, at most one real student).
